pageFooter.aboutText: - it's my account name across various selling platforms. I sell coins from my personal collection and more. Since I'm an amateur collector, I might make pricing mistakes - let me know if you see unfair price! I promise honest service and fast responses.
pageFooter.aboutTextAdditional: I have successfully completed many sales on various sites, and all buyers were happy. You can check it by feedbacks on next platforms:
pageFooter.iOffer: I offer international and domestic shipping.
pageFooter.iOffer2: You can select shipping method in order modal when click Buy.
pageFooter.packing: I pack all coins securely and hermetically, not detectable by touch when sent by mail envelope.
pageFooter.noTraceableRest: are not traceable, but from my experience they usually deliver pretty well even abroad (China, Canada, Europe). As proof of postage, I’m attaching a photo of the envelope and a video of dropping it into the postbox.
pageFooter.noTraceableAlert: The buyer takes full responsibility in case of shipment loss
pageFooter.termsBooking: Booking - means that the coins become inactive on this site for 24 hours but remain available for purchase on other platforms (Vatera, Galeria Savaria, Aukro).
pageFooter.termsOrder: After purchase (before payment), the coins are removed from this site’s listings but remain active on other platforms (Vatera, Galeria Savaria, Aukro) until payment is confirmed.
pageFooter.termsWarning: Priority is given to listings on other platforms until payment is received. Coins are removed from all platforms only after a successful transaction is confirmed by me.
